blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court (SC) has prompted respondents in the petition filed by election lawyer Romulo Macalintal to comment on his plea to declare Republic Act (RA) No. 12326 unconstitutional and stop the barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections (BSKE) postponement. Among the named respondents in the petition were the Office of the President, the Senate, the House of Representatives, and the Commission on Elections. During Wednesday’s full court session, the SC told respondents to comment on the petition as well as on the prayer of Macalintal to issue a temporary restraining order or a status quo ante order against […]...
